Your Hammer Miner DC08 hasn't shipped yet, and we should have written to you about that. Sorry for the silence. The units finished at the manufacturer and the batch ships September 30.

Before you go, one thing: you cancelled the first DC08 order on September 9, then ordered the same unit again two days later. What changed?
it was a miscommunication with a friend of mine, I ordered the DC08 originally, but canceled because of said miscommunication, I asked to cancel. But reordered after the misunderstanding occured.
Got it, thanks for explaining. One more: you went straight to the DC08 both times, no shopping around. Where did you first hear about that one?
ive watched and read a few videos and researched the alt coin miners that have low power consumption
That helps, thanks. Last one: was low power draw about the electricity bill, or about where the miner has to sit in your place?
honestly im planning on just canceling this order, I bought something else from another supplier since I havent heard back since then, so I needed something ASAP.

That's fair, and the silence is on us. The D.08 batch finished at the manufacturer and ships September 30, so that's two days out, not another open wait.

If you'd rather run two, keeping it costs you nothing and I can look at what I can do for the wait. Do you want me to hold it on that date, or are you set on cancelling?
im set on canceling. im sorry for the inconvience

No inconvenience at all, and no apology needed from you.

One last thing I can do: keep it on the September 30 ship date and put $50 back on your card for the wait. Two miners running is not the worst outcome. If that's still a no, I'll get the cancellation moving right away, in full, no restocking fee, since the delay is ours.
Thanks for the offer, but I would still like to cancel, im running a bitcoin miner aswell.
Handed to the team · Cancellation and full refund need a person; order also sits on a review hold.

Understood, cancelling it is.

Abel or Georges has been pinged to process it: the full $618.87, no restocking fee. Stay in the chat if you can and one of them will confirm here, otherwise it comes to your email. The money lands back on your card 3 to 5 business days after they issue it.
thats no worries, I can wait the 3-5 days. thank you for the help

Thanks for being easy about it. A copy of this whole conversation comes to your email once we're done, so you'll have the refund details in writing, and you can reply to that mail if anything comes up. Good luck with the new miner.
thanks, ill stay here until a human is available
Perfect, they've got everything they need from this chat, so it should be quick. I'll be here if anything else comes up while you wait.
thank you. and georges if youre reading this, thank you and sorry for the trouble. once again, thank you guys
He'll see it, and no trouble at all on our side. Take care, Anthony.
